_prompt_note: Frozen transcription prompt shared byte-identically by every VLM row (arabicfinbench/pipelines.py::PARSE_PROMPT). Editing it changes this hash, which is the intended alarm: results produced under different prompts are not comparable.
_route_note: Served via OpenRouter, not the vendor's own API. The same model on a different route can differ; the or_ prefix keeps the two from being conflated.
